query:
SELECT ct.*, u.email, u.name 
FROM creditsTransactions ct
LEFT JOIN users u ON ct.userId = u.id
WHERE ct.type = 'subscription_grant'
ORDER BY ct.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
